title: CAP Vision
description: To accelerate Pimpri-Chinchwad city's journey towards a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive and vibrant city by mainstreaming climate action into urban planning and development, enhancing quality of life, and contributing to India's national and global climate commitments, with a goal to achieve Net Zero by 2050.

title: CAP Objectives
description: Objectives of the Pimpri Chinchwad CAP are presented as Figure 20, which is an image/graphic in the source PDF. The itemised text of each objective was not extractable as text.

title: Net Zero Target Year
description: PCMC has set an internal Net Zero target aligned with national/global commitments.

title: India National Net Zero Target (context, not PCMC-specific)
description: Under the Paris Agreement, India aims to reduce emissions intensity by 45% by 2030 (from 2005 baseline) and achieve net-zero by 2070, per the 'Panchamrit' strategy.

title: Baseline GHG Emissions (2025)
description: Estimated total GHG emissions for Pimpri-Chinchwad city in the baseline year.

title: Per-Capita GHG Emissions (2025)
description: Baseline GHG emissions divided by population (33.14 lakh).

title: GHG Emissions by Source - Built Environment & Energy
description: Largest contributor to city GHG emissions per the Executive Summary GHG inventory breakdown.

title: GHG Emissions by Source - On-road Transportation
description: Second largest contributor to city GHG emissions per the Executive Summary breakdown.

title: GHG Emissions by Source - Waste Sector (total)
description: Waste sector total, comprising solid waste management (6%) and wastewater (3%), per Executive Summary.

title: GHG Emissions - BAU Scenario 2050
description: Business-As-Usual projected emissions for 2050, assuming no new policy interventions.

title: GHG Emissions - BAU Scenario 2070
description: Business-As-Usual projected emissions for 2070.

title: GHG Emissions - Ambitious/Net-Zero Scenario Reduction by 2050
description: Under the ambitious/Net-Zero scenario, this % of BAU-2050 emissions (91.6 lakh tCO2e) is targeted to be reduced by 2050.

title: Residual Emissions under Net-Zero Scenario (2050)
description: Emissions remaining after the 92% reduction under the ambitious scenario.

title: Priority Sectors Identified
description: Six priority sectors identified from the Vulnerability Assessment and GHG inventory for adaptation/mitigation strategy development: Energy and Buildings, Urban Mobility, Solid Waste Management (Municipal Waste Management), Urban Greening and Heat Mitigation, Water Resource Management, Air Quality.

title: City Population (Census 2011)
description: Historical population figure used for some baseline calculations.

title: City Population (2025 estimate, used for per-capita GHG calc)
description: Population estimate used in the GHG per-capita calculation.

title: City Area
description: Total geographic area under PCMC.

title: PCMC Climate Action Cell - Establishment
description: City Climate Action Cells were mandated under a Maharashtra Government Resolution (25 July 2024); PCMC's Climate Action Cell was established via PCMC General Body Resolution No. 4354 of 11 October 2024.
source_document: Illustrated, Simple Guide to PCMC's Climate Action Plan

title: Governance Structure - City Climate Action Cell (CCAC)
description: Governance anchored by the City Climate Action Cell (CCAC) and a high-level CCAC Committee; the City Transformation Office (CTO) serves as Secretariat to the CCAC.

title: Mitigation Definition (per CAP)
description: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions through energy efficiency, renewable energy adoption, sustainable mobility, waste-to-resource solutions, and low-carbon urban infrastructure.

title: Adaptation Definition (per CAP)
description: Enhancing the city's capacity to anticipate, absorb, and recover from climate shocks such as heatwaves, flooding, and water stress.

title: City Nickname
description: Pimpri Chinchwad is referred to as the 'Detroit of the East' due to its manufacturing/industrial base.

title: City Rank Among Maharashtra CAP Cities
description: Pimpri Chinchwad is the 5th city in Maharashtra to prepare a Climate Action Plan.
source_document: Illustrated, Simple Guide to PCMC's Climate Action Plan

title: Major Climate Risks Identified
description: Key risks identified for Pimpri Chinchwad: changes in rainfall patterns, flooding during heavy rainfall, water shortages, groundwater depletion, increased storms/cyclones, extreme heat/heatwaves, changes in seasonal patterns, changes in disease patterns.
source_document: Illustrated, Simple Guide to PCMC's Climate Action Plan
source_section: Why Climate Action Plan? - Climate Risks

title: Other Environmental Risk Factors
description: As Maharashtra's fastest-growing urban/industrial centre, PCMC also faces growing waste generation, loss of green spaces, traffic congestion, increasing air pollution.
source_document: Illustrated, Simple Guide to PCMC's Climate Action Plan
